Save metacleaner results to files

Source: R/write_results.R
write_results.Rd

Writes the cleaned database and a report of the removed sequences:

Usage

write_results(
  result,
  outdir,
  prefix = NULL,
  tax_format = c("taxonomizr", "lineage"),
  overwrite = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

result

The output of [clean_reference()].

outdir

Folder to write to (created if needed), e.g. `"cleaned"`.

prefix

File name prefix. Default: the prefix stored in `result`.

tax_format

Format of the `_clean.tax` file: `"taxonomizr"` (default; the comma-separated format used by metacleaner 1.x and as MetaCurator input: `taxid,accession,taxid,domain,...,species`) or `"lineage"` (tab-separated `accession` and a `k__;p__;...;s__` lineage string, as used by QIIME-style classifiers).

overwrite

Overwrite existing files? Default `TRUE`.

verbose

Print the names of the written files. Default `TRUE`.

Value

The paths of the written files, invisibly.

Details

* `<prefix>_clean.fasta`: the kept sequences (one line per sequence); * `<prefix>_clean.tax`: taxonomy of the kept sequences; * `<prefix>_flagged.tsv`: one row per removed sequence with its taxonomy, the hit that caused it to be flagged, that hit's taxonomy and the reason; * `<prefix>_summary.txt`: settings and counts per reason.

Examples

ex <- function(f) system.file("extdata", f, package = "metacleaner")
res <- clean_reference(ex("query.fasta"), ex("reference.fasta"),
                       ex("contaminants.fasta"), taxonomy = ex("taxonomy.tax"),
                       verbose = FALSE)
files <- write_results(res, outdir = tempdir(), prefix = "example")
#> Results written to /tmp/Rtmpy15j3I:
#>   example_clean.fasta
#>   example_clean.tax
#>   example_flagged.tsv
#>   example_summary.txt
files
#>                                 fasta                              taxonomy 
#> "/tmp/Rtmpy15j3I/example_clean.fasta"   "/tmp/Rtmpy15j3I/example_clean.tax" 
#>                               flagged                               summary 
#> "/tmp/Rtmpy15j3I/example_flagged.tsv" "/tmp/Rtmpy15j3I/example_summary.txt"
